stories.headline: Russia's Economy Minister Admits Reserves Depleted as Central Bank Cuts Rate and Lawmaker Warns of Revolution

key_facts.fact: Economy Minister Maxim Reshetnikov told a business conference that economic reserves 'have largely been used up' and the macroeconomic situation is 'substantially more difficult'
key_facts.excerpt: Our current records show that these reserves have largely been used up; this truly is the situation and the macroeconomic situation is substantially more difficult.

key_facts.fact: Russia's central bank cut the benchmark interest rate to 14.5% on April 25, the fifth consecutive half-point reduction, with Governor Nabiullina citing the Middle East conflict as a significant external risk
key_facts.excerpt: On Friday, the central bank slashed the benchmark interest rate again, marking the fifth straight half-point reduction, to bring it down to 14.5%. 'A significant risk from external conditions is the situation in the Middle East,' Governor Elvira Nabiullina said.

key_facts.fact: Communist Party leader Gennady Zyuganov warned parliament that 'a repeat of what happened in 1917 awaits us' by autumn if urgent financial and economic measures are not adopted
key_facts.excerpt: If you (the government) do not urgently adopt financial, economic and other measures, by autumn a repeat of what happened in 1917 awaits us.

key_facts.fact: Putin revealed in an April 15 televised meeting that GDP shrank by a combined 1.8% in January and February, with manufacturing, industrial production, and construction all negative
key_facts.excerpt: During a televised meeting on the economy on April 15, he revealed that GDP shrank by a combined 1.8% in January and February, adding that manufacturing, industrial production, and construction were negative.

key_facts.fact: Sweden's military intelligence chief said Russia's economy is weaker than it appears and its military-industrial complex is losing money, ravaged by corruption, and dependent on state bank lending
key_facts.excerpt: Sweden's military intelligence chief told the Financial Times that Russia's economy is weaker than it appears, adding that its military-industrial complex is losing money, ravaged by corruption, and dependent on lending from state-run banks.

stories.headline: SpaceX, Anduril Among 12 Firms to Win $3.2B Golden Dome Space Interceptor Contracts

key_facts.fact: The US Space Force awarded approximately $3.2 billion in contracts across 12 companies for the Golden Dome missile defense program's early phase
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX, Anduril and others secure $3.2Bn US Space Force contracts for Golden Dome project

key_facts.fact: Selected companies include SpaceX, Anduril, Palantir, Aalyria Technologies, Scale AI, Swoop Technologies, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and RTX (Raytheon)
key_facts.excerpt: Apart from SpaceX, the other companies involved include Anduril Industries, Palantir Technologies, Aalyria Technologies, Scale AI, Swoop Technologies, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and RTX (Raytheon).

key_facts.fact: The program focuses on building a space-based satellite network to detect and track missile threats including hypersonic weapons, using hundreds of LEO satellites instead of traditional ground radar
key_facts.excerpt: The idea is to use hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit to quickly spot missile launches and track fast-moving threats like hypersonic weapons across the globe.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX will contribute satellite constellation expertise and high-speed inter-satellite laser communication links for rapid data relay
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX's development of high-speed inter-satellite laser communication links gives it a technical advantage in supporting this type of architecture.

key_facts.fact: Anduril is expected to develop AI-powered command-and-control systems to process real-time satellite data, identify threats, and coordinate automated defense responses
key_facts.excerpt: Anduril is expected to develop AI-powered command-and-control systems that will process real-time data from satellites and sensors, identify incoming threats quickly, and help coordinate automated defense responses.

stories.headline: Intellia to Report First-Ever Phase 3 In Vivo CRISPR Gene-Editing Data on Monday

key_facts.fact: Intellia Therapeutics announced it will report topline data from HAELO, the first-ever Phase 3 trial of an in vivo CRISPR gene-editing therapy, at 8:00 AM EDT on April 27
key_facts.excerpt: Intellia Therapeutics to Report Topline Data from Global Phase 3 HAELO Clinical Trial of Lonvoguran Ziclumeran in Hereditary Angioedema on April 27, 2026

key_facts.fact: Intellia shares jumped 19.3% after hours to $16.26 on April 25, following a 14.1% decline during regular trading to $13.63
key_facts.excerpt: Intellia finished Friday at $13.63, sinking 14.1%. Then, after hours, shares bounced back 19.3% to $16.26

key_facts.fact: HAELO is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial with 80 participants evaluating a single 50mg infusion of lonvoguran ziclumeran for hereditary angioedema (HAE)
key_facts.excerpt: 80 participants were given either a single 50 mg lonvo-z infusion or placebo. The main measure: number of HAE attacks recorded between week 5 and week 28.

key_facts.fact: In Phase 1/2 data, 31 out of 32 patients on the 50mg dose stayed attack-free without ongoing prophylaxis, with follow-up reaching three years
key_facts.excerpt: In its earlier Phase 1/2 data, Intellia reported that 31 out of 32 patients on the 50 mg dose stayed attack-free and didn't need ongoing prophylaxis at the data cutoff.

key_facts.fact: If Phase 3 data are positive, Intellia plans a US biologics license application in H2 2026, with potential launch in H1 2027; the company holds $605.1 million in cash
key_facts.excerpt: If the data impress, company filings indicate a U.S. biologics license application could follow in the back half of 2026, teeing up a potential launch in the U.S. during the first half of 2027.

key_facts.fact: The therapy targets the KLKB1 gene in the liver to knock down kallikrein, a key protein in the swelling cascade; rivals include Ionis's Dawnzera and KalVista's Ekterly
key_facts.excerpt: Ionis secured U.S. approval in 2025 for Dawnzera, a preventive HAE therapy. Takeda's Takhzyro remains on the market. KalVista's Ekterly just made history as the first oral, on-demand treatment for acute HAE attacks to clear the FDA.
